note: the artifact the evidence pack cites for pathway_transfer, as records. the parquet and its permutation null are pinned by sha256; the records are what the acceptance tests read.

provenance.coverage_note: coverage NOT thresholded; any cut separating PCD~17% from Cell_Cycle~11% is arbitrary. representativeness reported per-pathway, reader-judged.

cited_by.pathway_transfer: z_he view, testable pathways with fdr_A < 0.05

pack_does_not_list.B3_v3: 4 of 4 testable pathways significant in the z_he view - present in the artifact, absent from the pack's candidates

view_clean_column: the script hardcodes R1-R4 as the runs whose ST input carries gpath2vec. B1_v3, B2_v3, B3_v3 and R5_v3 also carry it (st_features), so their z_st and z_mean rows are marked clean and are circular. no row in those views is significant, and every z_he row is correctly clean, so no cited number is affected. gate_h3_pathway derives circularity from st_features and reports the disagreement.
